Compact Utility Performance with Smooth Hydrostatic Control

Built to Work. Engineered for Everyday Versatility.

The CK3520HB combines easy-to-use hydrostatic operation with dependable diesel power and strong hydraulics for loader work, mowing, grading, and property maintenance. Its compact size and maneuverability make it ideal for working around buildings, fences, and tight spaces while still delivering the capability needed for demanding tasks.

Features May Include:

Efficient Diesel Engine
34.9 HP diesel engine designed for dependable power, fuel efficiency, and long service life.

Hydrostatic Transmission (HST)
Smooth pedal-controlled speed adjustment for easy operation and precise maneuverability.

4WD Capability
Provides improved traction and stability on uneven ground, mud, gravel, and slopes.

Loader-Ready Platform
Designed for front-end loader compatibility for lifting, digging, and material handling tasks.

Power Steering
Responsive steering system for improved handling and reduced operator fatigue.

Category I 3-Point Hitch
Compatible with a wide range of implements including box blades, tillers, rotary cutters, and finish mowers.

Comfortable Operator Station
Ergonomic controls, suspension seating, and open visibility for extended work sessions.

Durable Construction
Heavy-duty frame and steel body components designed for long-term reliability.
